name: Develop, extend, and debug software code
description: Users asked for assistance in writing, extending, debugging, and optimizing code across a wide range of programming languages, frameworks, and domains, including web applications, desktop software, systems programming, and data analysis. The requests covered the full software development lifecycle, from building complete functional applications and implementing specific features to fixing errors in existing code and developing specialized tools for audio, graphics, and networking.
